svg.title: LSTM cell state highway versus hidden state across "The cat sat"
svg.desc: The cell state flows continuously across all three timesteps largely unchanged, tapped by forget and input gates at each word, while the hidden state below it is recomputed fresh at every timestep to reflect the most recent word in context.

g.text: Cell state c_t — persists, barely changes

svg.text: Top row (c_t): a highway carrying long-term context, tapped by forget(f)/input(i) gates but never fully overwritten
Bottom row (h_t): a fresh "working memory" snapshot recomputed at every single step
